summary.text: Brock Martin is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 79 and a chiropractor who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which independent Kirk Carter is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Brock Martin lives in Huntingdon, Tennessee. He graduated from Camden Central High School in 2003 and earned a doctorate in chiropractic from Logan College of Chiropractic in 2010.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as co-founding and working as clinical director and chiropractor with Southern Chiropractic and Acupuncture.

He won the 2022 Republican primary for the open seat over Gordon Wildridge and the 2022 general election over Democrat Thomas Jefferson, succeeding Curtis Halford, and assumed office on November 8, 2022.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and as vice chair of the Insurance Committee.
